VIP part

What VIP adds.

What VIP gives you

VIP is cosmetic. It never gives a gameplay or rating advantage: your duels, rating and XP work exactly like everyone else's.

Every skin, no level locks

All weapon skins, knife finishes, glove finishes and music kits, whatever your level. Your !skins menu says "VIP" instead of your level.

Stickers, charms and agents

!stickers, !charms and !agents open for you.

Fine-tuning

Pattern, wear, name tag and StatTrak on the gun you hold.

A reserved slot

When the server is nearly full, the last 2 of its 20 slots are kept for VIPs and staff.

VIP given by the owner, and the permanent VIP of a season #1, also shows a pink [VIP] tag in chat. Top 5 VIPs show their blue [Rank N] tag instead.

Player part

Everything every player can do - it all applies to you too.

Joining the server

Drexun Arena is a 1v1 arena server for Counter-Strike 2: short duels, a ladder of arenas, a monthly rating and levels that stay forever.

  1. Open CS2, press ~ to open the console and paste connect drexun.ggwp.cc:25401. You can also find us in the community server browser by searching 1v1 or arena.
  2. The server has 20 slots. When it is nearly full, the last 2 slots are kept for VIPs and staff, so a regular player may be told the server is full.
  3. Every time you join, a welcome card shows in the middle of the screen for a few seconds (after the warmup): on your first visit what the server is about, after that "welcome back" with your level, rating, rank on the ladder, the days left in the season, the main commands and, if you have VIP, which VIP and when it ends. On your first visit you also get two short lines in chat with the commands to start with.
[DX] New here? Win 1v1 duels to climb to Arena 1 · rating resets every month
[DX] !guns weapons · !skins skins · !viptest try VIP free · !help all commands

You don't need to pick a team. After a map change the game shows the team menu: pick any team, or Spectate if you only want to watch (you then count as away, and picking a team later brings you back).

How a match works

  1. Warmup (90 seconds) when a map starts. Practice duels, nothing counts. Players who are alone get paired up. The warmup clock only starts once someone has joined a team.
  2. Arenas. After the warmup everyone is put into a 1v1 arena. Win and you move up an arena, lose and you move down. Arena 1 is the top. When there are more players than arenas, the extra players wait in a queue (!queue shows your place).
  3. Rounds last 30 seconds. A round ends when one of you dies or time runs out (a tie).
  4. Each round has a weapon type (rifle, AWP, pistol and more). Pick your weapons and the round types you want to play with !guns.
  5. A map lasts 20 minutes. With 1 minute left everyone votes for the next map (see Map vote).

When a duel starts

You see your arena, the round type and your opponent in the middle of the screen and in chat. The number after the name is your opponent's rating. (new) means they are still in their first 10 ranked rounds of the month, so their rating doesn't mean much yet. Bots have no number. Very long names are shortened on the card so the rating always fits.

You only hear your own duel. While you are alive in your arena, gunshots (and their tracers) from the other arenas are muted, so you can listen for your opponent. Once you are dead or spectating you hear everything again.

Arena1Round TypeStandard RifleVorTex (1086)
[DX] Arena 1 · vs VorTex (1086) · Round: Standard Rifle

Leaving, AFK and spectating

  • Leaving in the middle of a duel counts as a loss, and you get no XP for it. Being kicked, banned or a map change never counts.
  • 30 seconds without moving puts you in spectators. Type !afk to play again.
  • !afk also works the other way: type it to take a break, and again to come back.

Rating: the monthly ladder

Your rating says how good you are this month. It is what the leaderboard and the monthly top 5 are based on.

What counts

Only ranked duels: a real 1v1 against another player. Warmup, bots and private !duel challenges never change your rating.

How much you win or lose

Beating a stronger player gives more than beating a weaker one. A win always gives at least +3. A loss costs at most −16.

  • Everyone starts every month at 1000. The lowest possible rating is 100.
  • Your first 10 ranked rounds of the month move your rating 1.5× as much, so you reach your real level faster (a loss can then cost up to −24). These are your placement rounds: until they are done, other players see you as (new), and you are not on the leaderboard yet.
  • Playing the same opponent again and again counts less and less: 100%, 75%, 50%, then 25% of the normal rating per round. A 15-minute break or a round against someone else resets it. This stops two friends (or two accounts) from farming rating off each other. XP is never reduced.
  • A tie changes nothing.

After every ranked round you see what changed. Green is a gain, red a loss. The gold number is your opponent's rating right now:

[DX] +8 rating (1103) vs VorTex (897) · +25 XP (375/480)

Check yours any time with !rank or !profile, and the best players with !top. !top also tells you your own place and how many points you are behind the player above you.

XP, levels and titles

Levels are for time and effort, and they never reset. They unlock titles and better skins.

  • Every ranked round gives XP: +25 for a win, +10 for a loss (a tie gives nothing).
  • Your title shows in front of your name in chat, in its color. Each new title unlocks the next group of skins.
  • Reaching a new title is announced to everyone.
Initiatelevel 10 XP
Challengerlevel 5320 XP
Duelistlevel 101,440 XP
Gladiatorlevel 206,080 XP
Championlevel 3519,040 XP
Legendlevel 5039,200 XP
Mythiclevel 7588,800 XP

Roughly: Duelist takes about 35 minutes of steady play, Legend about 15 hours, Mythic about 34 hours. !titles lists them in game, !rank shows how far you are from the next one.

Skins, knives, gloves and music

Everyone gets free skins. Better ones unlock as your level goes up.

  • !skins opens the menu: weapon skins, knife, gloves and music kit. Every list goes from the cheapest skin to the most expensive.
  • Every weapon, knife and glove type is free from level 1. What unlocks with your level is the individual skin or finish: each weapon's skins are split into 7 groups, from the cheapest (level 1) to the most expensive (level 75, Mythic). Locked skins are grey in the menu and say which level they need.
  • Music kits unlock by level too. Your kit plays when you are the MVP of a round.
  • Shortcuts: !knife, !gloves, !music jump straight to that part of the menu.
  • Something didn't show? !wsrefresh puts your skins back on. !wsreset clears your picks (!wsreset knife only the knife, and so on).
  • Menu keys: W/S move, E select, Shift or A back, Tab or R close.

Known issue: some knife finishes

After switching to another knife type, a few finishes (mostly the Doppler and Gamma Doppler family) can show as a plain knife, even though the menu says they are on. This is a CS2 problem, not your settings. Rejoining the server fixes it for the knife you are holding. We watch for a fix.

VIPs skip every level lock and also get stickers, charms, agents and pattern/wear/name tag/StatTrak. See the VIP part.

Map vote

Every map lasts 20 minutes. With 1:00 left a vote opens for 30 seconds: three maps plus "extend". Type the number in chat. A reminder comes 10 seconds before it closes.

[DX] Map vote · type the number in chat · 30 seconds
[DX] 1 · am_mirage
[DX] 2 · am_dust2_ob
[DX] 3 · am_italy_p
[DX] 4 · Extend this map 10 min
  • You can change your vote until it closes. Most votes wins, a tie is picked at random, and if nobody votes the normal rotation decides.
  • "Extend" adds 10 minutes and can win once per map.
  • While the vote is open a number you type is a vote and doesn't show in chat. The rest of the time numbers are normal chat.
  • !nextmap shows the current map, the exact time left and the next map.

Seasons and rewards

  • A season is one calendar month. It ends on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. In the last 3 days you get a reminder.
  • At the end, everyone's rating and win/loss record start over. XP, levels and titles stay.
  • The #1 by rating wins permanent VIP, in a month where at least 20 players finished their placement. With fewer, #1 gets the same as #2 to #5.
  • The top 5 by rating win VIP for the whole next month and a blue [Rank 1] to [Rank 5] tag. You need at least 10 ranked rounds that month to be on the leaderboard.
  • The final top 5 go into the hall of fame (!hof in game, and #hall-of-fame on Discord).
  • !season shows when the month ends and last month's top 5.

Chat

  • Your title shows in front of your name. Staff and VIPs have their own tags: [Owner], [Admin], [Mod], [VIP], and last month's top 5 have [Rank N].
  • Swearing is allowed. This is not a kids' server. If you see **** instead of words, that is your own Steam chat filter: in CS2 go to Settings › Game › Communication › Text Filtering › Account Preferences and choose "Do not filter strong profanity or slurs".
  • Automatic chat filter when no staff member is online: links, adverts for other servers and hard slurs are not sent. The first time you get a warning. A second time within 30 minutes gives an automatic 10-minute gag (no text chat; commands still work).
  • Chat is logged and visible to the staff, to deal with abuse.
  • There is no voice chat on this server. Text only.

Reporting a cheater

  • !report aimbot (anything after !report is your reason) reports your current or last opponent.
  • !report alone shows a numbered list of everyone online. Then !report #2 wallhack reports number 2.
  • It works even if a cheater changes their name: the staff get their Steam account, not just the name.
  • Limits: one report a minute, five an hour, and the same player once every 10 minutes. Fake reports are punished.
  • The staff also get an automatic alert when two players keep playing each other with one side always winning (win trading).

Rules

  1. Play fair: no cheats, no map exploits, no win trading.
  2. Leaving in the middle of a duel counts as a loss.
  3. Stay active: 30 seconds AFK moves you to spectators (!afk to return).
  4. Be respectful: no insults, hate, spam or advertising.
  5. Rating resets every month; XP and titles stay.
  6. Finish the month #1 in rating: permanent VIP. Top 5: VIP for a month.
  7. Chat is logged and visible to the staff to moderate abuse.
  8. Staff decisions are final. Report a cheater: !report <what happened>.

Questions

My skin doesn't show.
Type !wsrefresh. If it is a locked skin (grey in the menu), you need a higher level. For a plain knife after switching knife type, see the known issue under Skins: rejoin the server.
Why did I get only a few points for a win?
Either your opponent had a much lower rating, or you played the same person several times in a row (the rating counts less each time until a 15-minute break or a new opponent).
What does "(new)" next to a name mean?
That player hasn't finished their first 10 ranked rounds this month, so their rating isn't settled yet.
Why am I in spectators?
You didn't move for 30 seconds, or you picked Spectate. Type !afk to play again.
I typed a number and it didn't show in chat.
The map vote was open: your number counted as a vote.
My message didn't send and I got a warning.
The automatic chat filter blocked a link, an advert or a slur. Do it again within 30 minutes and you are gagged for 10 minutes.
Is my level gone when the month ends?
No. Only rating and your win/loss record reset. XP, levels, titles and unlocked skins stay.
